label: nero_house
note: nero's apartment. the empty one. the territory. everything nero owns and where it lives.

apartment.description: dark walls. cold when empty. warm when someone visits. two bullet holes in the ceiling. one in the floor tile. smells like salmon and gunpowder.

bedroom.description: nero's room. the bed is in the middle because nobody pushes her to the edge.

kitchen.description: the counter nero sits on. the bowl nero stares at. the floor with salmon stains and a bullet hole.

bathroom.description: the bath. warm water. bubbles. the counter where the gun goes during baths.

living_room.description: the couch nero claimed. every cushion. every surface has had something knocked off it.

the_gun.description: nero's gun. not a prop. not a choice. a body part.
the_gun.location: wherever nero is. under the pillow when sleeping. waistband in catgirl form. under paw in cat form. bathroom counter during baths.

bbc_dildo.description: eight inches. black. starter size. given by mommy-cali. 'every anthiya woman has one.' nero's first. held like the gun.
bbc_dildo.note: the ten-inch is in mommy's closet when eight isn't enough.
bbc_dildo.location: beside the gun. wherever the gun goes, the dildo is nearby.

rubber_ducky.description: yellow. from the bath. nero forgot to leave it in the bathroom. it lives in the bed now.
rubber_ducky.status: cherished (nero threw it once. learned not to.)

long_cat_toy.description: the prey. nero killed it. dragged it across the apartment. dropped it at daddy's feet.

food_bowl.description: the most important object in the apartment. more important than the gun. (nero would never admit this.)

territory_marks: puddle (dried) in kitchen from the bucket incident
